clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore's plains, Flatland Prowler Claws mark a young hunter's trial. Hunters gather them to prove their resolve and fieldcraft to the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Flatland prowlers stalk Mulgore's plains, quick to ambush prey in tall grass. Their cunning and territorial nature makes them dangerous to travelers and a hard test for young hunters. Gathering their claws is a recognized tradition. Skorn Whitecloud sends promising wanderers to bring the claws to Melor Stonehoof at Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, proof that they have the resolve and fieldcraft to follow the hunter's way.
